codeReview.summary: Transactions UI implementation is comprehensive (list/card views, CRUD modals, validation, loading/empty/error states, and tests), but date rendering uses timezone-sensitive parsing that can show the wrong calendar day for LocalDate API values.

issues.description: formatDate parses backend LocalDate strings with `new Date(dateString)`, which treats `YYYY-MM-DD` as UTC and can shift the displayed date by one day in non-UTC timezones. TransactionsPage relies on this formatter (frontend/src/pages/TransactionsPage.tsx:320,379), so 'Mar 15, 2026' can incorrectly render as the prior day for many users.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The frontend-worker skill does not document jsdom responsive-testing behavior (both mobile and desktop DOM branches render), which led to custom test patterns in this feature.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff skillFeedback suggests adding this note; transactions tests use helper `expectTextPresent` with `getAllByText` to handle duplicate responsive elements (frontend/src/__tests__/TransactionsPage.test.tsx).

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared library docs do not capture a safe frontend pattern for formatting backend LocalDate strings without timezone drift.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Backend transaction date is LocalDate (backend/src/main/java/com/expensetracker/dto/response/TransactionResponse.java), while formatter uses `new Date(dateString)` (frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts:15).

summary: Feature is close to complete, but a blocking date-formatting bug can display incorrect transaction dates outside UTC; report marked fail until date rendering is made timezone-safe.
